meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会召集 5 个立场彼此敌对的“评审”,让他们逐个攻击你的规划草案——分别负责挑过度设计、查漏洞、要证据、批架构、出奇招——只保留经得起反驳的结论,再强制交给 plan 助手整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“adversarial plan”等触发词,或提出需要极高严谨性、想挑出薄弱假设/盲点/过度工程的规划时,技能会接管并进入对抗式讨论。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划新功能的上线方案。
say.note: 五个敌对评审会开始互相批判你的方案。

say.text: 对这个计划做 adversarial plan,重点挑薄弱假设和盲点。
say.note: 进入对抗式辩论,只留站得住的结论。

say.text: 启动 hpp,严格审查架构,防止过度工程。
say.note: 之后会交给 plan 助手写成可执行计划。

howto.what_en: Claude activates 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', forms 5 hostile reviewers (skeptic/validator/researcher/architect/creative) for cross-critique, keeps only surviving insights, then hands them to the `plan` agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan the rollout of this feature.
say_en.note: Five hostile reviewers will attack your plan.

say_en.text: Run an adversarial plan on this proposal to expose weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Only defensible insights survive the debate.

say_en.text: Start hpp and stress-test this architecture against over-engineering.
say_en.note: Then the plan agent formalizes an executable plan.
